## Review checklist

- [ ] Requirement/flow and API/data ownership are clear
- [ ] Specification reflects changed behavior; targets are not presented as results
- [ ] Relevant tests pass; unverified behavior is explicitly named
- [ ] No secrets, private settings, customer exports or generated output
- [ ] Existing records/migrations are preserved; necessary new migration is included
- [ ] New dependencies/provider/cloud spend have a recorded reason and approval
- [ ] TODOs added/resolved and validation are recorded in commit bodies
